lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible on the mid-lateral flank, organized into approximately five horizontal rows and eight vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a checkerboard pattern of anchor nodes across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper flank; the primary ridge displays a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and distinct shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a non-uniform distribution of high-luminance blobs, with a higher concentration in the anterior-basal region and sparser distribution toward the posterior and apical margins.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five commensal fish (remoras) is visible trailing the pectoral fin and swimming along the ventral surface.
